captionStarter: Commanders 33-31 over Seahawks. Seattle's first loss since November.
concept: Meme of the Week slide: Seahawks' win streak dating back to November vs. the pick-six freeze frame that ended it
description: The Washington Commanders beat the Seattle Seahawks 33-31 on a 50-yard interception-return touchdown with 3:57 left, handing Seattle its first loss since November.
headline: Commanders stun Seahawks with late pick-six, 33-31
